Name: Ohodavi-style Rasmodius for SVE
Author: ErrantWitch
Description:
So, you wish [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839?tab=files]Ohodavi[/url] had drawn that young and very cute rendition of the wizard? Yeah, me too. But until they do, have this instead!
This is set to not apply if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]Romanceable Rasmodius Revamp Redux[/url]; I have yet to draw sprites for that mod.
[size=1]Or at least, it's supposed to check against it. I don't actually play with these mods normally, can you believe it?[/size]
[b]
Be advised, this is untested in vanilla. Any issues arise, grab my attention on the official Stardew Valley Discord, as this is my first mod release on the Nexus.[/b]
[size=1]Can you tell from the very unpolished description page?[/size]

Special thanks for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3226]Rizumu85[/url] for allowing me to include an SVE-compatible spritesheet!

Manifest.Name: Anime Chaekal-Rizum
Manifest.Description: Wizard designed by Chaekal, redrawn in Ohodavi's style by a nameless amateur! And ported by Tea-Loving Lad.
Manifest.Author: ErrantWitch and Tea-Loving Lad
